description: Master fader and VU meters for a bus chain, summing the three stereo buses to a stereo mix out and passing them on separately at the master level

params.text: Turns the output on and off at the FADE IN and FADE OUT times; ctrl-click skips the fade, and a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions this Bus Depot and mutes every other one in the patch
Sets the level of the aux input, which is added to the red stereo bus ahead of the master fader; fully clockwise is unity
Sets the level of all three stereo buses together, after which they are summed to MIX OUT
Sets how long the ON button takes to take the output down, 26ms to 34 seconds
Sets how long the ON button takes to bring the output up, 26ms to 34 seconds

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V turns the output on or off, with the same fade the ON button uses, except while an audition is running
Scales the MASTER LEVEL knob, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched the jack reads 10V, so the knob alone sets the level
The left channel of the aux input when R is patched; with R empty, every channel of the cable arriving here is summed and fed to both sides of the red bus
The right channel of the aux input; patching here stops the L/M/P jack from being summed and fed to both sides
Takes the three stereo buses from another module's BUS OUT
Sets the fade time in place of the FADE IN and FADE OUT knobs, 26ms at 0V rising to 34 seconds at 10V; the menu chooses whether it replaces the fade in, the fade out, or both

outputs.text: The left channels of all three stereo buses summed, after the master level and the fade
The right channels of all three stereo buses summed, after the master level and the fade
Carries the three stereo buses on one polyphonic cable after the master level and the fade, kept separate, so a mix group can go on to another Bus Depot or to send effects

notes: this is where a bus chain ends; it needs another Glue the Giant module's BUS OUT patched into its BUS IN, and its own MIX OUT jacks are what carry the three buses summed to stereo
holding any Bus Depot's ON button for 0.7 seconds puts every Bus Depot in the patch into audition, that one heard and the rest muted; a single click on any of their ON buttons ends it
menu: Level CV Filters — chooses No filter or Smoothing (default), which slews the level CV over 26ms from silence to full and takes the clicks off a stepped CV
Fade Speed Modulation — chooses which knob the fade CV replaces: Fade in and fade out (default), Fade in only, or Fade out only
Audition Modes — chooses Normal (default) or Always audition, which keeps this Bus Depot playing while another one is being auditioned
